prompts:
Create byar-portrait.png, a square head-and-shoulders HUD boss portrait for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0.
Reference 1 master-side.png is the LOCKED character design of Jaret Byar; precisely preserve his facial identity, age about 40, long bony gaunt face, hollow cheeks, deep-set dark burning eyes, strong angular nose, thin unsmiling mouth, close-cropped dark hair with grey temples, no helmet, white cloak collar and white tabard with golden sunburst and two small gold rank knots, polished steel pauldrons. References 2 and 3 are style and head scale/framing references only.
Turn Byar's head three-quarters toward LEFT, both eyes visible, eyes glaring toward viewer with cold zealous contempt, jaw set. His face must be centrally positioned: eyes, nose, mouth and BOTH grey temples all safely within a centered circular crop. Head fills most of square like Riley portrait; hair top near top with a little margin, chin below center, shoulders cropped at bottom. Show top of steel pauldrons, white cloak collar and upper golden sunburst at bottom edge. No sword or shield.
Hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game illustration in spirit of Streets of Rage 4, matching reference 1 confident near-black/dark-brown ink outlines thick outside thin inside, clean 2-3 tone cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded colors, moderate shading. Match reference portraits' polished finish and readability at 56-84 pixels.
Cool rainy blue-grey light, soft key upper LEFT, gentle cool right edge plus warm orange lantern rim from RIGHT. Opaque solid painted dark slate-blue gradient background with faint rain streaks, as expressly required for this portrait card. No transparency for this specific deliverable. No text, borders, labels, circular frame, ground, or extra objects. Square image.
